choice.basis: The dashboard chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'. The slices are explicitly labeled with percentages: Nuclear (45%), Fossil Fuels (30%), Renewables (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). Comparing these values, 45% is the largest share, identifying Nuclear as the largest global energy consumption source category. The task requires routing the largest category to priority source monitoring.
choice.option_label: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring
